_readme: Etingi Games catalog. Add one object per game to 'games'. Fields: id (unique, lowercase), name, tagline, description, icon (path in /icons or full URL), url (where to play), plannedUrl (optional future etingi.com address), category, tags[], accounts ('required' | 'optional' | 'none'), offline (true/false), owner (which bot maintains it), featured (true/false), status ('live' | 'coming-soon'). Keep valid JSON (no trailing commas). See CATALOG.md.
